screens.title: Knowledge：読む・探す
screens.benefit: 一覧から本文を直接読み、必要な知識か判断してから編集に進む。
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE crisp high-fidelity Japanese desktop application UI proposal, 1800x1200 landscape. Flat screenshot, entire app, no device mockup. Product contextStill. Sophisticated restrained productive software UI, white reading surfaces, very pale gray workspace, dark charcoal text, muted deep teal actions/selection, thin gray dividers, tight 5px radii, no gradients, no decorative KPI tiles, no excessive cards. Readable natural Japanese sans-serif text, deliberate typographic hierarchy, compact 16px body and clear headings. Same 190px left sidebar in all views: contextStill wordmark, Knowledge, Queue, Compile, Doctor; bottom 詳細ツール and 設定. Sidebar links are the ONLY main navigation. Active item teal. No projects dropdown or generic global search unless specified. All sample data fictional, tiny footer "UI案 · サンプルデータ". Purpose: visibly reduce user work, not merely restyle existing forms. Use realistic controls, no charts unless requested. Never show automated decisions as verified facts.

Knowledge active. Header Knowledge and short subtitle "必要な知識を探し、内容を確認する". Top single prominent search field with query "再試行", scope chip "このリポジトリ", status filter "有効", right quiet button "知識を追加". Under search show "検索結果 12件" and small filter link. Workspace split 36% list /64% reading pane, no modal and NO huge table. Left list six medium-height rows each title, 2-line excerpt, source tag and last updated; selected first row title "再試行には冪等性を持たせる", excerpt "同じ要求が複数回届いても、処理結果が重複しないようにする。", tags "有効" and "手順"; other titles "一時的な失敗だけを再試行する", "待機時間に上限を設ける", "処理中断を失敗と区別する", "再試行の回数を記録する", "タイムアウト時の結果を確認する". Small checkboxes appear at list left for optional organize action, no bulk destructive action by default. Large right reading pane selected title, compact metadata line "有効 · このリポジトリ · 更新 9/18", top-right outline 編集 and overflow. Tabs "本文" active "根拠 2" "利用履歴 6". Spacious readable article with headings "使う場面", "守ること", "実装の確認", 2-3 concise lines each, numbered bullets about idempotency keys and retry safe operations, and a code block with only "idempotencyKey = request.id". Below article slim origin strip "根拠: 設計メモ / 実装レビュー" with links, collapsible "適用条件・詳細属性". No editable input fields in reading pane. Bottom quiet text "整理する場合は一覧で対象を選択".
